title: BuildKit
description: Data file content/build/kit.json: the construction kit for building plans (D471 D3/D5/D6, B4b R14). The core sends shapes, colours and limits with every build_plan job; the game draws each part from its shape and colour. Colours follow the warm comic palette (D355). Values are placeholders until Marcel decides.

shapes.description: Shape ids the builder may use (from content/vocabulary/shapes.json).

colors.description: Colours the builder may use, by id.

max_parts.description: Most parts in one building plan.

max_part_size_m.description: Longest edge of one part in metres.
